title: Repo-owned vs host-local: remember is durable, not exhaust
content: Project-scoped `remember` entries are durable repo-owned knowledge, not operational exhaust — they travel with the repo in `.bbox/knowledge/` alongside `learn`/`decide`. Only live threads, side-channel notes, and pins are host-local exhaust. When deciding where a project-scoped store belongs: durable+reviewable (knowledge, decisions, remembered facts, settled/promoted thread records) → committed `.bbox/`; high-churn session/bro/task-bound activity → host-local. See design/corpus/knowledge/repo-owned-project-state.md.
